findings.title: aria-hidden missing on decorative images
findings.problem: Both elements have alt="" and role="presentation" but no aria-hidden="true". Some assistive technologies (e.g. older VoiceOver on iOS) surface role="presentation" nodes via touch exploration regardless of the role.
findings.impact: A user on an affected AT will hear the decorative gradient images announced while navigating the workflow editor, defeating the intent of the accessibility fix.
findings.recommendation: Add aria-hidden="true" to both elements alongside the existing alt="" and role="presentation".
